name: hellofresh-mcp
description: Unofficial HelloFresh (US) tools for Claude — subscription, weekly deliveries, menus, meal picks, skips and box sizes via your signed-in browser

hellofresh_ws_port.title: Bridge port
hellofresh_ws_port.description: The fetchproxy bridge port. The whole fetchproxy fleet and ContextMint Bridge share `37149`; override only for local testing (or when a host injects a per-registration port). Defaults to 37149.

confirm_mode.title: Write confirmation mode (optional)
confirm_mode.description: Optional. What a confirmation-gated HelloFresh change (meal picks, skips, box size, delivery day) does on a client that cannot show a confirmation prompt: "ask-user" (default: the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and the model must get your approval in chat before using it), "auto" (the model may use the token after reviewing the preview itself) or "refuse". An unrecognised value is treated as refuse. Leave blank for the default.

confirm_elicitation.title: Confirmation prompts (optional)
confirm_elicitation.description: Optional. "off" never shows a confirmation prompt, so every client gets the confirmation-mode flow. Set it for a client that says it can show prompts but never does. Defaults to on. Leave blank for the default.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Log the browser bridge role and lifecycle to stderr. Diagnostic only; off by default.

profiles.title: Planner profiles (optional)
profiles.description: Optional. The meal-planner profiles as an inline JSON array, e.g. [{"name":"family","people":4,"kidFriendly":true,"premiumCapCents":500}]. Wins over the profiles file. Leave blank for the file or the built-in couple/family profiles.

profiles_file.title: Planner profiles file (optional)
profiles_file.description: Optional. Path to a JSON file of meal-planner profiles. Defaults to ~/.config/hellofresh-mcp/profiles.json (used only when it exists).

tools.name: hf_healthcheck
tools.description: Check the ContextMint Bridge link, the HelloFresh session token and a subscriptions-endpoint probe (status only).

tools.name: hf_get_subscription
tools.description: Read the subscription: box size, price, preset, delivery slot and frequency, next delivery and cutoff, voucher (never name, email, address or payment).

tools.name: hf_list_deliveries
tools.description: List upcoming delivery weeks: dates, cutoff, status, box size and an estimated total with the voucher discount (brief view: one line per week).

tools.name: hf_get_delivery
tools.description: Read one delivery week: dates, status, box size, current meal picks, allowed actions, alternative days and an estimated total including premiums.

tools.name: hf_get_menu
tools.description: Read a week's menu at its box size, with seafood/kid-friendly/time/premium/selected filters and protein swaps.

tools.name: hf_list_box_sizes
tools.description: List the box sizes (meals x people) the subscription can switch to, marking the current one.

tools.name: hf_recent_picks
tools.description: List the meals picked in recent weeks (best effort, unreadable weeks named) to avoid repeating a recipe.

tools.name: hf_select_meals
tools.description: Pick the meals for one delivery week (replaces the current picks), confirm-gated and verified by re-reading the menu.

tools.name: hf_set_week_size
tools.description: Change one week's box size (people, optionally meals) only, keeping its delivery day; confirm-gated and verified.

tools.name: hf_set_week_delivery_day
tools.description: Move one week's delivery to another offered day/slot, keeping its box size; confirm-gated and verified.

tools.name: hf_skip_week
tools.description: Skip one delivery week (nothing delivered or charged) before its cutoff; confirm-gated and verified.

tools.name: hf_unskip_week
tools.description: Unskip one skipped delivery week before its cutoff; confirm-gated and verified.

tools.name: hf_change_plan_size
tools.description: Permanently change the plan's box size (meals x people); confirm-gated and verified by re-reading the plan.

tools.name: hf_change_delivery_schedule
tools.description: Permanently change the regular delivery slot and/or frequency (every 1-4 weeks); confirm-gated and verified.

tools.name: hf_list_profiles
tools.description: List the meal-planner profiles (servings, meals, categories, preferences, premium cap) and where they were loaded from; local config only.

tools.name: hf_suggest_meals
tools.description: Suggest a week's dinners for a planner profile (e.g. a 4-person kid-friendly week), with alternates and reasons; read-only.

tools.name: hf_weekly_plan
tools.description: Plan a delivery week for a planner profile: box size needed, suggested picks, estimated total, approval summary and the follow-up writes; read-only.
